Through years of innovation, we have developed a line of expandable garden hoses that offer a practical and efficient alternative for gardeners seeking reliability and ease of use.
Rethinking the Garden Hose Experience # Traditional hoses often present challenges such as knotting, heavy weight, and cumbersome storage. Our expandable garden hoses are engineered to resolve these issues. Lightweight and virtually knot-free, these hoses simplify both usage and storage, making them a suitable choice for a wide range of gardening tasks.
Product Range # Our expandable garden hose collection includes several models, each designed to meet specific needs:
25 feet Expandable Garden Hose - (No.E502025) Freeze-Proof Expandable Garden Hose -(No.E502526) Expandable garden hose -(No.E502561) Expandable garden hose -(No.E502765) No Kink Expandable Garden Water Hose -(No.E5026611) Expandable garden hose -(No.E502062) Expandable garden hose -(No.E502734) Engineering for Performance and Durability # Our expandable hoses are protected by US invention patents (US9,074,711 B2 & US9,453,601 B2) and feature a double extension design. The use of high-strength polyester fiber and advanced knitting techniques ensures that these hoses withstand regular use and challenging conditions better than many alternatives.
A notable feature is the self-repair capability. If damaged, the hose can be restored using a C buckle and basic DIY skills, which can significantly extend its lifespan and reduce replacement costs.

Flexible and Easy to Maneuver: The hoses are lightweight and can be easily navigated around gardens, vehicles, or outdoor spaces. Space-Saving Storage: When not in use, the hose contracts to a compact size, eliminating the need for bulky reels and making it ideal for small gardens or urban spaces. Kink-Resistant and Self-Draining: These hoses resist kinks and automatically drain after use, reducing maintenance and frustration. Whether for watering plants, washing vehicles, or cleaning patios, these hoses offer a streamlined and efficient solution for modern gardeners.

content:
Flat Garden Hoses for Reliable Outdoor Use # Hung Ta’s heavy-duty flat garden hoses are engineered to deliver exceptional durability and performance across a wide range of environments. Constructed from high-quality, eco-friendly materials and free from PVC inner tubes, these hoses are designed to withstand both extreme heat and cold. Unlike traditional hoses, they remain flexible and do not freeze or crack, even in temperatures below zero—a common issue with standard PVC hoses during winter months.
With a bursting pressure of 600 psi, these flat hoses are built to handle high water pressures without risk of bursting or leaking. The UV-resistant exterior ensures the hose maintains its integrity and functionality even with prolonged exposure to direct sunlight. Additionally, the robust construction resists leaks, abrasions, and punctures, making these hoses a dependable choice for demanding gardening and outdoor tasks.
Heavy Duty Flat Garden Hose - No.F502829 Heavy Duty Flat Garden Hose - No.3502249-5 Heavy Duty Lightweight Garden Flat Hose | No.3502250 Superior Flexibility and Handling # A key advantage of these flat hoses is their flexibility and ease of use. Unlike traditional round hoses, which can be cumbersome and difficult to maneuver, the flat design allows for easy rolling and compact storage. This makes it simple to move the hose around obstacles or sharp turns, and its lightweight nature reduces physical strain during use.
Efficient Water Flow and Self-Draining Design # Efficiency is central to the design of these hoses. The smooth interior minimizes friction and pressure loss, ensuring a steady and uninterrupted flow of water—ideal for tasks that require high water volume, such as filling pools or irrigating large gardens. Notably, models like No.3502249-5 feature a self-draining capability, allowing the hose to air-dry within 24 hours after use. This helps prevent the growth of bacteria or moss, keeping the hose clean and ready for its next use with minimal maintenance.
Versatility for Multiple Applications # These heavy-duty flat hoses are suitable for more than just gardening. Their high water flow capacity and resistance to tangling and kinking make them practical for agricultural use, transporting water over long distances, or navigating around multiple obstacles. Leak-proof connectors ensure secure and reliable connections, minimizing water waste. Whether watering your garden, washing your car, cleaning a yacht or pool, or even pet washing, these hoses offer a versatile and dependable solution.
For more information or to discuss your specific needs, contact us to learn how our heavy-duty flat garden hoses can enhance your outdoor tasks.
